Name: Tox's Kitty Jelly Slimes
Author: toxicToxophilite
Description:
This mod is PNGs only, you must replace the assets! This is only for the Jelly slimes. If the other slime types have interest, perhaps I'll make conversions for them too.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2058?tab=description&BH=2]Kitty Slimes[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7912]Kitty Tiger Slimes[/url].
